**Repaired finding submitted: T4C — deviation, preferred-level cure.**

Change made in response to the verifier:

- The refund element is now carried in **operative language inside new Section 9.4** rather than relying on Section 10.2: "...in which case Vendor shall refund, on a pro-rata basis, all prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination." This fixes both defects the verifier identified — the absence of an express *pro-rata* basis and the narrowing to *recurring* Fees only.
- Section 10.2 is left untouched, so its breach-related refund of unusable Fees survives unchanged.
- The inserted paragraph now carries the "9.4" number in its text (matching the style of 9.1–9.3 and 9.5), so the new cross-reference "subject to Section 9.4" in Section 2.1 resolves.
- Section 2.1 edit remains the narrow deletion of "or termination", preserving "without reduction rights".
- Coverage rebuilt: all four preferred elements are now `addressed_by_operation`; no `already_met` reliance remains. No "in whole or in part", survival tail, or procedural extras added.
